title: 艾翁·树上的小窝
description: 高瘦树人艾翁温柔扶着树枝上的小鸟窝，青苔胡须和长木肢保留鲜明轮廓。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Ivern is a very tall slender tree-like forest being with long wooden limbs, a kindly carved face, a mossy beard, leafy brows, and twisting branch-like head growth. Preserve the organic bark silhouette and green growth rather than clothing him as a normal man. His hands have rounded twig fingers and his posture is gentle, with no sharp threatening branches or dark forest horror.
art_direction.scene: He bends carefully beside a small living tree and steadies an empty little bird nest while a round songbird watches from a nearby branch. One moss-covered stone and a patch of tiny flowers ground the scene. The long body curves softly within the square, emphasizing care, scale, and a friendly face under a broad leafy canopy.
art_direction.palette: moss green, warm bark brown, pale leaf, butter yellow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
